title: KYC Policy
policy_text: Every customer must complete identity and address verification before an account is activated. Full KYC must be refreshed every 2 years for high-risk, 8 years for medium-risk and 10 years for low-risk customers.

title: Anti-Money Laundering Policy
policy_text: Transactions that show unusual patterns, structuring, or unexplained high value must be escalated to the Compliance Officer within 24 hours for review.

title: Data Protection Policy
policy_text: Customer personal and financial data must be encrypted at rest and in transit, and access must follow least-privilege role-based controls.

title: Credit & Lending Policy
policy_text: Loan applications require income proof, credit bureau check, and a debt-to-income ratio of no more than 50 percent for unsecured loans.

title: Grievance Redressal Policy
policy_text: Customer complaints must be acknowledged within 24 hours and resolved within 30 days, with escalation to the nodal officer if unresolved.

title: Fraud Management Policy
policy_text: Accounts with suspected fraudulent activity must be frozen immediately pending investigation and reported per regulatory timelines.

title: Dormant Account Policy
policy_text: An account with no customer-initiated transaction for 24 months is classified as dormant and requires re-KYC to reactivate.
